picks.title: Adobe Premiere is adding a Generative Media Tool
picks.excerpt: Adobe's new Generative Media Tool lets editors create AI-generated video and sound effects directly on the Premiere timeline — drag across empty track space, prompt, and choose a model — without leaving the NLE.
picks.rationale: Highest actionability in the pool — generation moves onto the Premiere timeline itself, so editors fill gaps and SFX without round-tripping to a separate AI tool.

picks.title: Higgsfield Debuts 'Kök Börü' Showcasing Hybrid Human-AI Animation Pipeline
picks.excerpt: Premiering at SIGGRAPH 2026, the 15-minute animated short — a historical drama rooted in Central Asian folklore — was made by a team of 12 in two weeks on the Higgsfield platform. The studio walked through a hybrid, human-conditioned pipeline built on hand-drawn character designs, props and painted textures.
picks.rationale: A documented human-conditioned pipeline — hand-drawn design and painted textures steering generation — with a concrete 12-artists-in-two-weeks production benchmark.

picks.title: FREE SAM2 Matting Tool
picks.excerpt: A free SAM2-based matting tool demoed for AI filmmakers — segmentation-driven roto/matte extraction that slots into a generative-video post workflow.
picks.rationale: Free and immediately usable — the cheapest way to add clean roto/mattes to a generative-video shot tomorrow, and a fresh tool rather than commentary.

picks.title: Creatives from 'Sharknado' and 'Doctor Who' Are Now Making AI Films
picks.excerpt: For its new slate, the startup Promise AI is pairing traditional screenwriters and showrunners with generative creators — including releasing the animated AI film 'Tuning In' — as a test of what a hybrid AI film crew looks like.
picks.rationale: Craft hook rather than business noise — it shows how a hybrid crew is actually staffed, with writers and showrunners sitting beside generative artists on a shipped film.

picks.title: Raindance Film Festival, AI Platform IMGN Launch New Film Fund and Development Hub for Indie Filmmakers
picks.excerpt: Raindance and AI platform IMGN are launching a development hub that puts generative production tooling — plus financing — in the hands of independent filmmakers.
picks.rationale: More than a funding note: a festival-backed hub that hands indie filmmakers an actual generative production toolchain they can apply to use.
